comment: Batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, W2b: group counts authored from the group definitions where ChemSep's were refused by the W2a import (E-PPR78 for cyclohexane, propylene, butene-1, isobutene and butadiene; modified UNIFAC (Dortmund) for ethylene). Each entry keeps ChemSep's other scheme.

eppr78-2022.source: Authored in batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents (W2b) from the E-PPR78 group definitions, ChemSep's PPR78 counts having put ring or alkenic carbons in plain alkane groups: Jaubert et al. 2022 (Fluid Phase Equilib. 560, 113456) Tables 1 and 2 and the PPR78 alkene groups it builds on (Qian, Privat and Jaubert 2013): G10 CH2,cyclic a ring CH2; G18 CH2,alkenic an alkenic =CH2 or =CH- carbon; G19 C,alkenic an alkenic =C< carbon; G1 CH3 and G2 CH2 the alkane groups. Cyclohexane: six ring CH2.

modified-unifac-dortmund.source: Authored in batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents (W2b) from the modified UNIFAC (Dortmund) group definitions, ChemSep's counts (2 CH2) having put both alkenic carbons in an alkane group: ethylene CH2=CH2 has no subgroup of its own; it is counted as one CH2=CH (subgroup 5 of main group 2, C=C), the alkenic subgroup with a terminal CH2, so its main group is right and its volume and area (R 1.2832, Q 1.6016) are those of the vinyl group.
